title: Adaptive embedding onboarding: shadow traffic, golden metrics, and safe swap policy
creator: Priya Desai
description: Introduce a guarded, tenant-aware onboarding and versioning workflow for embedding models that prioritizes semantic quality, latency bounds, and cost scaling. This ticket defines the shadow/onboarding flow, golden testset evaluation, safe-swap and rollback criteria, and required telemetry for automated gating. The goal is to reduce regression risk when swapping embedding models while enabling fast adoption of improved models across tenants.
background: We currently allow embedding model swaps using simple canaries and per-tenant pinning, but we've observed regressions in quality for some tenants and inconsistent latency increases when new models are heavier. We need a standardized onboarding path that captures quality (MAP@k, nDCG, recall), latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), and cost delta before ramping traffic. The flow should support shadowing, staged traffic ramps, and automated rollback triggers.
goals: Provide a reproducible shadowing process that runs new model inference in parallel and collects golden-metric deltas per tenant
Define deterministic acceptance criteria for swapping a model at tenant and global levels
Automate ramping with safety gates based on quality, latency, and cost thresholds
Add dashboards and alerts for onboarding experiments and enable post-swap validation hooks
non_goals: End-to-end tenant migration UI (handled in a follow-up ticket)
Major redesign of the serving runtime — we will add small runtime flags and telemetry only
Changing embedding API surface or embedding contracts
acceptance_criteria: Shadow mode can be enabled per-tenant and globally via config with <1% extra tail latency when sampling at 10% of traffic (observed in load test)
Golden set evaluation job runs nightly and computes MAP@10, nDCG@10, recall@100 for both baseline and candidate models with stored deltas
Automated gating engine rejects a staged swap if semantic-quality delta < -0.5% absolute on MAP@10 for high-traffic tenants unless manually overridden
Latency guard: candidate model p95 must not exceed baseline p95 by more than 30ms for latency-sensitive tenants
Roll forward plan: traffic ramp schedule (0% -> 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%) implemented with automated health checks and rollback on failure
Telemetry: per-tenant dashboards show traffic %, MAP delta, p50/p95/p99 latency, token-cost delta, and anomaly alerting within 5 minutes of crossing thresholds
perf_targets: Shadow sampling overhead < 1% end-to-end latency at baseline load for 10% sampled traffic
Nightly evaluation completes within 2 hours for 1M example golden set
Canary step evaluation (5% traffic) generates metric staleness < 10 minutes
rollout_plan: Stage A - Dry-run (shadow only): Enable shadow for target tenants for 48 hours. Collect metrics and compare against baseline. No traffic changes.
Stage B - Micro-canary: Ramp to 5% traffic for 24 hours for non-latency-sensitive tenants. Run automated checks every 15 minutes.
Stage C - Partial roll: If micro-canary passes, ramp to 25% for 6 hours for the same tenant cohort and continue checks.
Stage D - Broad roll: Ramp to 50% then 100% over 48 hours for approved tenants with monitoring and rate limits on cost delta.
Stage E - Deprecation plan: Tag previous model as deprecated and sweep low-usage tenants for migration within 90 days unless pinned
telemetry_requirements: Per-request metadata: tenant_id, model_variant, request_size_tokens, response_size_tokens, inference_time_ms, cache_hit_bool
Derived metrics: MAP@10, nDCG@10 (sampled offline), latency percentiles per tenant/model, per-token cost delta
Alerts: quality_drop (MAP drop > configured threshold), latency_regression (p95 delta > configured threshold), cost_spike (cost delta > +20%)
tasks: Add shadow-mode flag to embedding router (config + per-tenant override)
Implement nightly golden-eval job with pluggable metric computation
Add gating rules to rollout controller and expose operator API for overrides
Instrument per-request embedding telemetry and wire into observability pipeline
Create staging dashboards and pager rules for onboarding experiments
Write smoke tests and chaos tests that validate rollback behavior under failure
Draft runbook for operators describing manual rollback, tenant pinning, and post-mortem template
dependencies: ENG-80211 (router: per-tenant routing overrides and flags)
PM-410 (product: tenant rollout policy and pricing guidance)
risks_mitigations: Risk: Shadowing adds tail latency under very high load. Mitigation: implement sampling cap, backpressure on shadow queue, and synthetic load testing before enablement.

Risk: Offline golden sets may not represent tenant-specific queries. Mitigation: collect per-tenant golden subsets and require high-traffic tenants to have at least one representative golden subset before swap.
Risk: Cost regression from heavier models. Mitigation: require cost delta report and set cost guardrails; block automatic ramp if cost > configured absolute or relative threshold.
Risk: False negatives in metric computation due to data skew. Mitigation: run sanity checks and compare multiple metrics (MAP, nDCG, recall) before rejecting
